comment: Slots this SITE declares on top of the ones the freeze derives from the Blux export. Consumed by `blux freeze --extra-slots`, which validates and appends them to the slot manifest so `blux migrate-frozen` pushes them to Prismic. They exist because the byte-faithful template carries no token for them: the export ships no <video> poster attribute, and the availability panel was a flattened PNG that the render rebuilds as real text. Keys must start with 'x.' (the freeze's reserved prefix). Availability entries are generated by availabilitySlots() in ../availability.ts and held in lockstep by availability.test.ts — edit there, not here.
urlNote: Image urls here must be ABSOLUTE and fetchable: `blux migrate-frozen` downloads each one to upload it as a Prismic asset. x.poster names its Prismic home rather than this site's own /worthe-aerial-labelled.jpg, for two reasons. The freeze appends these slots to home.slots.json, which the offline /dev/blux-frozen fixture renders — and an absolute url on our production origin is same-origin only IN production, so it tripped the img-src CSP everywhere else and turned the gate red. Pointing at images.prismic.io is CSP-clean at every origin AND is exactly what production serves, so the fixture renders the real poster. The committed static/worthe-aerial-labelled.jpg remains the render's fallback (VIDEO_POSTER) if the slot ever goes missing.
